arabic_text: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ رَجُلًا سَمْحًا، إِذَا بَاعَ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى، وَإِذَا اقْتَضَى
english_translation: May Allah have mercy on a man who is kind when he sells, when he buys, and when he asks for payment.
question: What is the correct translation of the phrase 'سَمْحًا' in this Hadith?

arabic_text: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ رَجُلًا سَمْحًا، إِذَا بَاعَ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى، وَإِذَا اقْتَضَى
english_translation: May Allah have mercy on a man who is kind when he sells, when he buys, and when he asks for payment.
question: In which authentic collection of Hadith is this saying of the Prophet (pbuh) recorded?

arabic_text: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ رَجُلًا سَمْحًا، إِذَا بَاعَ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى، وَإِذَا اقْتَضَى
english_translation: May Allah have mercy on a man who is kind when he sells, when he buys, and when he asks for payment.
question: What is the main Islamic teaching established by this Hadith?

options.A: Muslims must always sell at the lowest prices
options.B: Debt collection should be done through legal authorities only
options.C: Kindness and good conduct should be shown in all business transactions
options.D: Business dealings are discouraged in Islam
